subject: or_legislature/2025R1/SB612
title: Directs the Department of Corrections to establish and update a list of each undocumented individual who has been charged with or convicted of a crime in this state and each crime for which an undocumented individual has been charged or convicted.
headline: SB 612 did not pass

claims.text: SB 612 was introduced in the Senate on January 13, 2025.
SB 612 was still in a Senate committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
